coverage_assessment: Ten captured searches covered English, French and Dutch general, weekly, farming-sector, Brussels/port and local-outlet terms. One Jan30 Zeebrugge report was body-read and coded pending a specific headcount; a Jan31 convoy report supports a second candidate but no person count or home-state demand. A first broad query response was genuinely lost before persistence; the Le Monde lead is held by a saved publisher restriction and AP body retrieval failed before HTTP. Bounded, non-exhaustive; early-month and regional/local searches were noisy, and no official baseline is available.
